about: The collecta of the formulary “18th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the working of Your mercy, we beseech You, O Lord, guide our hearts, for without You, we cannot please You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
